info.name: HR SaaS – Employees API
info.description:
Covers every endpoint in `EmployeeController` (`/api/v1/employees`): list, get, hire, update, terminate.

**Run the whole collection in order** (Collection Runner or `newman run`). The *Setup* folder signs up a fresh tenant per run and stores tokens and IDs in collection variables, so later requests depend on it.

Prerequisites: `docker compose up -d` and the app running on `{{baseUrl}}` (default http://localhost:8080).
